Here is a concise algorithm of how to start learning Lojban.

Duplicate resources were removed to make it shorter and thus more effective.

# Start reading [[The Crash Course (a draft)|"The Crash Course"]]
# after reading first sections of Chapter 1 you may read [https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1Yrxt9gAtqA_oSDD76Toq8VLSZjjOxJ5rkKsxFs3Cw8E/pub?start=true&loop=false&delayms=5000 Lojban in simple phrases], (also available in [http://mw.lojban.org/images/d/d1/Lojban._How_to_quickly_create_sentences.pdf PDF]). You may read parts of it when you like and return to it whenver you like. No need to consume the whole introudction at once. Consider it an alternative introduction for another point of view.
# Use whenever you like: use the [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/jb/index.html#sisku/coi dictionary app] for the Crash Course and the [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/en/index.html#sisku/pluka live dictionary], which has more words although they are added by live speakers and may not always be proofread.
# Use whenever you like: try searching for arbitrary words in the [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/i/muplis/index.html#sisku/pluka database of sentences]. Note that not all of the sentences are proofread by fluent speakers of Lojban.
# Use whenever you like: join [https://mw.lojban.org/extensions/ilmentufa/irci/ the chat] and try talking to other Lojbanists when they appear there. Try asking them questions.
